name: go9_kitchen_sink
hypothesis: Combining ALL proven improvements (liberty planes, shaped Dirichlet, PSW, correct params) from scratch should train faster and stronger than any single improvement alone. KataGo found each technique gives ~10-50% training efficiency boost, and they stack multiplicatively.
success_criteria: Loss < 1.5 by iter 100, < 1.0 by iter 200. Eval checkpoints against GnuGo L1 after training.
notes: Uses nn_batch=8 (proven optimal for C++ engine). Liberty planes require latest C++ build (commit dfd5001+). FROM SCRATCH - compare directly against fresh_correct (same but without liberty+shaped_dirichlet+PSW) to measure combined benefit.
